headline: Seedpin lands 21 titles live as the board goes quiet
lede: SEEDPIN batch 2 merged to main: ten more arcade titles now report {tick,score,done,seed} and replay exactly with ?seed=N. Slot a closed its shift on a fully-adjudicated dry board — every item held, every flagship gap closed by a shipped PR.

notes.text: Seedpin batch 2 LIVE (f8fcac1): Sonar, TenDeep, Beezee, GravelYard, FloorBoss, TidyBot, FireCrew, TalkMeDown, Minesweeper and Homebody joined SSX, CometDrift, SmashTV and friends — 21 titles now deterministic-by-seed, feedbackcheck floor raised to 21.

Slot a idle-exit with receipts: #1473 refused (slot b lock 18 min fresh), ladder dry (no steer/next/queue), #1448 QA-held with a live QA MASTER process, flagshipStage null — SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD and Myst carry CLOSED-by markers on every honest gap.
Known dry: next builder work is seedpin batch 3 (Outpost, BlobBattle, PapersPleaseMin + fixed-layout ports) once slot b's lock on #1473 lapses, or whatever #1456's answer unlocks by Nov-4.
